newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds-Prices mixed in quiet activity.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds-Prices mixed in quiet activity.

text.p: Cash millfeed prices were mixed on Tuesday in subdued activity, millfeed dealers said.
"It was so quiet but I am pretty well sold up next week," a Minneapolis dealer said.
He noted some buying interest for nearby millfeed. "We do not have big discounting going on but we have limited trading," he said.
Another dealer said he believed the feed mills have already booked through March. There is some fill-in spot orders and that is holding the market up, a Carolinas dealer said.
"We see no real change in demand," a Buffalo dealer said.
"It is quiet and we probably will drift to the bullish side," he added.
This market is a "non-event," another dealer said.
